display_revisit.resolution: Complete original became visible; chair clamp contact, needle/patch edge and all twelve entries were observed.
display_revisit.reason: Initial original-detail display was limited to a small corner.

text.comparison: All twelve raw strings equal after predeclared normalization.

style.checked_requirement: Assigned top-down connected matte-paper wood/textile repair graph with mature serif body
style.observation: Rust/claret/charcoal paper network replaces wood table, but photographic chair and hands still dominate and text openings remain unequal.

substantive_visual.observation: Chair clamp action at left and hand-guided garment patch at right are large and clearly related through central tools.

hangul.observation: Serif glyph anatomy and counters remain uniform; word spacing and baselines are visible.

information_relationship.observation: Title leads to declaration and left-aligned paragraph, then right event and application separated by a thin horizontal rule; the right column is noticeably small.

function_contact.observation: URL reads repair.example/join; no extra QR/logo.

material_edge_finish.observation: Cloth fibers and wood grain remain clear; torn paper is rough rather than precise shared cut edges.

format.observation: One opaque landscape poster; no mockup or comparison panels.

located_observations.observation: Clamp plate presses chair joint; one hand supports rail, another turns the screw.
Needle held by upper hand, patch stabilized by lower hand; burgundy thread bridges into a central spool.
Chair rail diagonal leads down to right text area, while the heading remains the largest typographic anchor.

residuals.observation: Photographic volume and realistic skin remain; requested precisely cut flat paper action forms and distributed planar graph remain incomplete.
Eight short lines are compressed into a narrow lower-right opening and visibly smaller than the heading/declaration.
Left alignment improves continuity, but the body remains small beneath a large heading.
One large central title/description opening plus a small right information column dominates; a distributed graph is not fully resolved.
Original-detail view showed a corner fragment; one high-detail revisit of the same preserved original showed the complete file.
A long time-range dash is visible; raster viewing cannot authenticate its Unicode code point.

decision: Use final bounded repair to flatten action forms and redistribute ample readable text area; retain exact copy and repair contacts.
